note = new "Launch windows" "Mars and Earth line up for a low-energy transfer only about every twenty-six months. Miss the window and the trip costs far more fuel, or waits for the next one.

Perseverance left in July 2020 and landed in February 2021. Seven months is the usual length of the crossing."
